p: How hast thou helped him that: You concluded nothing, for neither did you help me while destitute of all help, nor yet speak sufficiently on God's behalf, who has no need for your defence.
savest thou the arm that hath: But you do not apply it to the purpose.
came from thee: That is, moves you to speak this?
Dead things are formed from under: Job begins to declare the force of God's power and providence in the mines and metals in the deep places of the earth.
naked before him: There is nothing hidden in the bottom of the earth but he sees it.
destruction hath no covering: Meaning, the grave in which things putrify.
north over the empty place: He causes the whole earth to turn about the North pole.
compassed the waters with bounds: That is, he hid the heavens which are called his throne.
day and night come to an: So long as this world endures.
pillars of heaven tremble and are: Not that heaven has pillars to uphold it, but he speaks by a similitude as though he would say heaven itself is not able to abide his reproach.
serpent: Which is a figure of stars shaped like a serpent, because of the crookedness.
how little a portion is heard: If these few things which we see daily with our eyes, declare his great power and providence, how much more would they appear, if we were to comprehend all his works.
